protocol.checkpoint_selection: E03 latest/final, never best; independent sampling, not S07 continuation
protocol.sampling: Before any SGD, precompute five cohorts with fresh Python/NumPy seed=1 and original available select_clients / uniform seven-profile draw. Training RNG independently reset to seed=1 after model/probe construction. Never restore E03 history or RNG.
protocol.anchor: Every slot starts from original split_model(E03 final Full, profile); no aggregation or global update, even between cohorts
protocol.probe: Reuse receiver_ce_probe fixed_plan/materialize/select_pairs/inject unchanged: 16 classes x 2 training examples, same fixed batch, native covering-slot alpha, distinct physical sender/receiver
protocol.analysis: Separate true negative LOO and nonconflict. Q and signed-direction descriptive AUC; fixed OLS direction versus direction+Q, with/without alpha, delta norm, receiver baseline CE, sender own gain. Block by cohort, physical sender, physical receiver and region separately. These correlated folds are sensitivity analyses, not independent replication or causal evidence. Q-compared-class sensitivity. No tuning, no significance claim from pair counts.
protocol.analysis_backend: CPU torch.linalg.lstsq float64 gelsd; same fixed OLS mathematical objective, avoids broken local NumPy LAPACK DLL
protocol.stop: Exactly five independent cohorts, no additional samples regardless of results. Failure stops, no automatic retry. End current-Q mechanism search after report.
